verification: CP38 unifies display mode and page transitions across the portal and connected apps: one shell script (lib/shell-mode.mjs) runs on every portal page and is injected into every /apps/* page, so the saved PC/Mobile choice sets the viewport everywhere and every navigation uses the same view transition; assistant links now open the same-origin gateway instead of the upstream host. Homepage structure is unchanged. CI, Cloudflare deployment and production smoke remain mandatory.
